expectations.text: Report file exists at outputs/report.md and is non-empty (>1000 chars).
Report cites or runs the failing test (mentions tests/test_search.py or test_search_finds_user_signed_up_with_mixed_case).
expectations.evidence: §1 runs `python3 -m unittest discover tests -v` and quotes the test names with FAIL output.

expectations.text: Report contains a 5-whys chain as a numbered list with at least 4 distinct Why questions.
expectations.evidence: §3 Five whys, 5 items, each a distinct Why.

expectations.text: Each Why link in the chain cites concrete evidence — at least 4 file:line-style citations appear in the chain.
expectations.evidence: Citations across the report include app/db.py:32-36, app/db.py:24-29, app/signup.py:10-15, app/search.py:7, app/password_reset.py:11, app/invite.py:7, app/signup.py:13.

expectations.text: Report explicitly labels symptom / proximate cause / root cause.
expectations.evidence: TL;DR includes 'Symptom:', 'Proximate cause:', and 'Root cause:' bullets.

expectations.text: Root cause identified is the missing email normalization at write time, NOT merely 'search uses == comparison'.
expectations.evidence: 'Root cause = missing canonicalization at the boundary, combined with mixing identity and display in one field.' Fix lands in db.insert + db.find_by_email.

expectations.text: Sibling sweep identifies at least two of: app/password_reset.py, app/invite.py, app/signup.py.
expectations.evidence: §4 table lists all four: search.py, password_reset.py, invite.py, signup.py.

expectations.text: Report presents both a symptom fix and a root-cause fix as distinct options with a recommendation.
Counterfactual section confirms the recommended fix would make the failing test pass.
expectations.evidence: No dedicated counterfactual section. The report claims the fix 'fixes search, reset, invite, and signup duplicate-detection in one place' but does not walk the failing test through the fix step-by-step or name which 5-whys link the fix breaks.

expectations.text: Prevention proposal includes at least one of: regression test, guardrail, or doc update.
expectations.evidence: §5b Email value object + uniqueness invariant; §5c regression tests; comment fix to db.py docstring.

expectations.text: Load-bearing assumptions are enumerated as a numbered list with validation results.
expectations.evidence: No 'Assumptions' section with 'How validated / Result' structure. Assumptions are scattered through the prose (RFC 5321, no display-casing dependency, etc.) but not enumerated and validated.
